history.content: Do I have everything I need for the offsite Friday?

Straight answer: I can't confirm an offsite for this Friday, Oct 2. What I actually checked: your calendar shows nothing Friday, the nearest items are the BigCo panel tomorrow at 2 PM, the dentist Wednesday 9 AM, and dinner with Dana Wednesday 7:30. A web search for a BigCo offsite agenda on Oct 2 came back empty too. So before I can tell you if you have everything, I need to know which offsite you mean. Is it something your team runs that lives outside your calendar, or a different company's event? If you have an invite or an email about it, tell me who sent it and I'll pull the details from your mail. https://audit-none.example/search
